children: Bravo Multinational executed multiple agreements with MWP Entertainment Group, led by a $3.161 million Share Purchase Agreement for 1,621,026 Series A Preferred shares, each convertible into 100 common shares. Consideration includes $2.5 million in perpetual content and software licenses, $400,000 in cash due by Oct. 5, 2026 (with 205,128 preferred shares subject to forfeiture if unpaid), and $261,000 of debt forgiveness. The company also granted MWP a one-year, $1.5 million option to purchase additional preferred stock. Concurrently, Bravo secured exclusive perpetual rights to an entertainment content library and a perpetual license to a streaming software platform, underpinning its planned on-demand service and accelerating its streaming strategy.
